title: Usage Anomalies Scrapbook and Sprint Stubs — June 2026
content:
SUMMARY:
This is a lightweight scrapbook of small but recurring customer-reported anomalies (usage patterns that break assumptions) plus a compact catalog of sprint-sized patches we can realistically deliver in 1–2 sprints. Goal is to capture raw signals, quick hypotheses, and concrete probe ideas for Eng + Product to triage.

Topline observations (from May–Jun support + AE threads):
- Burst misrouting: several Hosted customers (mid-market SaaS) report intermittent 5–10s tail latency spikes when burst traffic > 500 concurrent connections; spikes decay after 30–90s. Appears correlated with autoscale warmup and model variant fallback.
- Streaming stalls: customers using streaming chat with long contexts (3–4k tokens) see periodic 10–20s stalls mid-stream (client sees no bytes). Often follows token-limited retries.
- Console noise: devs confused by ambiguous error code 429X (appears in console and usage export) — many interpret as rate limit; actually it's a composite oversubscription + model-mismatch signal.
- Private-deploy key rotation friction: one regulated customer reported failed calls for ~6 hours after KMS rotation; root cause: agent-side cert cache + kube rolling semantics.
- Embedding drift complaints: customers running batched embedding pipelines saw 2–3% reranking churn after a rolling upgrade to a quantized model variant (no civil regression alert triggered).

Representative customer quotes (verbatim snippets):
- "We get these random pause moments during demos — impossible to explain to customers. Looks like the model just... stops." — AE note, fintech customer
- "Why does the dashboard say 429X? I thought we had plenty of quota." — eng lead, edtech customer

Raw signal counts (approx, aggregated from CS tickets + monitoring):
- Burst misrouting incidents: ~18 incidents across 10 accounts (May–Jun), median recurrence 2 days
- Streaming stalls: ~25 incidents across 7 accounts, most reproducible on long-context workloads
- Console 429X queries: ~120 support pings in last 60 days

PROBE HYPOTHESES (quick checklists):
- Burst misrouting: hypothesis = routing controller delays when new pods added + model-fallback logic re-evaluates kernel selection causing short stalls. Fast check: correlate pod-create timestamp with spike start in traces (obs team).
- Streaming stalls: hypothesis = KV-cache rehydration + backpressure bounce when client retry happens. Fast check: reproduce with controlled long-chat harness and artificially injected retry after token-limit.
- 429X ambiguity: hypothesis = single code used for >1 internal condition; surface separate codes + tooltip in Console. Fast check: audit code map in gateway and map to telemetry dimensions.

SPRINT-STUB CATALOG (small, scoped changes — target 1 sprint each):
1) Console clarifications for 429X (low risk, high ROI)
   - Change: split 429X into 429T (throttled) and 429O (oversubscribe), add tooltip + help link
   - Effort: FE + small gateway change + e2e test — 3 dev days
   - Owner: Product Console + Eng Gateway

2) Streaming retry guard (medium risk)
   - Change: add client-side/edge guard that detects mid-stream silence >5s and sends a non-retry sentinel to server; server will attempt soft resume from latest KV state rather than naive retry
   - Effort: server proto + SDK change + test harness — 7–10 dev days
   - Owner: Serving Runtime + DevX

3) Autoscale warmup telemetry (low effort)
   - Change: emit warmup start/stop events to traces; add dashboard to correlate warmup with tail latency spikes
   - Effort: SRE + Observability — 2–3 dev days

4) Private-deploy rotation checklist (operational, short)
   - Change: publish a runbook + pre-rotation hook to flush cert caches and verify agent roll order
   - Effort: Docs + small init script — 1–2 dev days
   - Owner: Private Deploys + Solutions Eng

5) Quantized rollout smoke tests for embeddings (quality-protect)
   - Change: add automated embedding-consistency check after model variant rollout; if rerank delta > threshold, auto-block or alert product
   - Effort: Eval infra + product rule — 5 dev days

QUICKPATCH CATALOG (smaller fixes we can hotpatch):
- Gateway: add metric "fallback_eval_ms" to track time spent in fallback kernel selection
- Runtime: log KV cache misses with request-id to trace streaming stalls
- Console: add search across error codes and link to active incidents

PRIORITIZATION NOTES (impact / effort intuition):
- Console clarifications = highest immediate CS ROI (low dev cost, reduces many pings)
- Autoscale telemetry = low effort, high visibility — unblocks root-cause for burst misrouting
- Streaming retry guard = higher effort but addresses painful customer-facing symptom (demos failing)
- Quantized rollout guard = medium effort but prevents regressions at cost of blocking releases — tactical win for teams with heavy embedding usage

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / RISK NOTES:
- Are the stalls client or server primary? Need an instrumentation plan to pin this down (obs + runtime)
- Will splitting 429 codes create churn in existing customer integrations that parse error codes? Consider a deprecation window + migration docs
- Private-deploy KMS rotations may require customer-side orchestration; check whether we can surface a pre-rotate validator instead of forcing changes server-side

NEXT STEPS (recommended owners & SLA):
- CS: triage top 10 customers impacted and open scoped repro tickets (Maya + Ibrahim) — due 2026-07-07
- Observability: add warmup and fallback metrics (Elena) — due 2026-07-10
- Product Console: scope 429 split + tooltip work, draft UX copy (Ravi) — due 2026-07-08
- Runtime/Serving: prototype streaming retry guard and KV-miss logging (runtime team) — spike 1 week

NOTES TO SELF (informal):
- Keep this doc lightweight. I'll feed distilled bits into CS signalboard and link the runbook once private-deploy script is written.
- Related: see CS-4821 for full ticket list and threads.

ATTACHMENT: quick test script suggestions (for Eng)
- harness/long_stream_repro.py: open X concurrent long-chats (n=40), inject random client retry at T+6s, collect stall latencies.
- embed_smoke.py: run 2000 pairs pre/post rollout and compute top-10 rerank delta.

END
